question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Sita : An Illustrated Retelling of the Ramayana'?
solution:
The correct answer is **Devdutt Pattanaik**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devdutt Pattanaik** is a renowned Indian author known for his writings on mythology.
 
• His book **'Sita: An Illustrated Retelling of the Ramayana'** provides a unique perspective on the Ramayana from Sita's point of view.
 
• Devdutt Pattanaik uses illustrations and narratives to make ancient texts accessible to modern readers.
 
• He has written several other books on Indian mythology, bringing ancient stories to contemporary relevance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**'Sita: An Illustrated Retelling of the Ramayana'** is a book that retells the epic Ramayana from the perspective of Sita, the wife of Rama. It provides insights into her thoughts, emotions, and the trials she faced.

 
 

 Character
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Sita**
 The central character of the book, known for her strength and resilience.
 
 

 **Rama**
 Sita's husband and the protagonist of the Ramayana.
 
 

 **Ravana**
 The antagonist who kidnaps Sita, leading to the epic battle in the Ramayana.
 
 

 **Hanuman**
 A devoted follower of Rama who plays a crucial role in Sita's rescue.
